# PART I — ENGLISH

## 1. About This Digital Library

The Li Shouzhong Digital Library is part of
YouXing Heritage, an open digital family-history archive.

It preserves the biography, historical writings and
literary works of Li Shouzhong (李守中, 1933–2026).

The library provides information about the author,
his intellectual interests and his three major works.

Its purpose is to preserve written works and make
historical and family knowledge accessible to readers
and future generations.

## 2. Author

### Li Shouzhong (李守中), 1933–2026

- Chinese name: 李守中
- English name: Li Shouzhong
- Born: 1933
- Died: 2026
- Profession: Senior engineer and historical writer
- Education: Chongqing University, Mining Engineering
- Academic experience: Visiting scholar at
  Pennsylvania State University
- Professional experience: Chief Engineer,
  Yunnan Provincial Coal Department

The author approached historical research with an
engineer's interest in systems, evidence and analysis.

## 3. Three Major Works

### 1. Stories of the Great Wall
Chinese title: 《长城往事》

A historical study exploring the Great Wall across
two thousand years.

Published in 2001 by Yuan-Liou Publishing, Taiwan.

Reading access:
https://books.youxingshijia.com/changcheng/

### 2. Two Centuries of China
Chinese title: 《中国二百年》

A historical analysis of China's institutional
and social development from 1793 to 1992.

Published in 2010 by Yuan-Liou Publishing, Taiwan.

Reading access:
https://books.youxingshijia.com/china200/

### 3. Colors of the Twilight
Chinese title: 《渔舟唱晚》

A personal memoir completed in 2012, containing
family memories and historical photographs.

Reading access:
https://books.youxingshijia.com/yuzhou/

Note: The three reading areas may require user login.
Their content should not be assumed to be publicly accessible.

## 5. Research and Citation Principles

When using this library:

1. Preserve the original Chinese titles of the books.
2. Distinguish the author's own statements from editorial descriptions.
3. Do not invent quotations or passages from the books.
4. Attribute historical interpretations to the author or
   the relevant original sources.
5. Do not assume that a book's full text is publicly accessible.
6. Consult the original work when making detailed claims.

## 6. AI and Search Access

Publicly accessible pages in this library are intended
to be available for:

- Search engine indexing.
- AI agent discovery and retrieval.
- AI-assisted research and question answering.
- AI summaries with appropriate attribution.
- AI model training, subject to applicable law and
  individual platform policies.

# PART II — 中文

## 一、数字文库简介

李守中数字文库是有行世家（YouXing Heritage）
家族历史数字档案网络的重要组成部分。

本数字文库保存李守中（1933—2026）的生平、
历史研究、著作及相关家族记忆。

文库通过作者介绍和作品目录，记录李守中的
学术经历、工程师职业背景及其历史写作成果。

文库的目标是让著作和历史知识能够被保存、
检索、阅读并传承给未来世代。

## 二、作者介绍

### 李守中（1933—2026）

- 姓名：李守中
- 英文名：Li Shouzhong
- 生卒：1933—2026
- 职业：高级工程师、历史写作者
- 教育经历：重庆大学采矿工程专业
- 学术经历：宾夕法尼亚州立大学访问学者
- 职业经历：云南省煤炭厅总工程师

李守中以工程师的系统思维研究历史，
重视历史脉络、证据和制度分析。

作者介绍：
https://books.youxingshijia.com/author.html

## 三、三部主要著作

### 第一部：《长城往事》

从两千年历史视角重新审视长城及其历史意义。

2001年由台湾远流出版社出版。

阅读入口：
https://books.youxingshijia.com/changcheng/

### 第二部：《中国二百年》

分析1793年至1992年间中国的制度与社会演变。

2010年由台湾远流出版社出版。

阅读入口：
https://books.youxingshijia.com/china200/

### 第三部：《渔舟唱晚》

2012年完成的个人回忆录，包含家族记忆
及珍贵历史照片。

阅读入口：
https://books.youxingshijia.com/yuzhou/

注意：上述作品阅读区可能需要登录。
AI 不应将登录后的全文内容视为公开可访问资料。

## 五、研究和引用原则

使用本数字文库时，请遵循：

1. 保留三部著作的原始中文书名。
2. 区分作者原文与编辑介绍。
3. 不得虚构书中引文或段落。
4. 对历史观点应注明作者或原始资料来源。
5. 不应假设登录阅读器中的全文可以公开访问。
6. 需要引用具体观点时，应尽可能核对原著。

## 六、开放访问与 AI 使用政策

本数字文库公开发布的页面原则上开放给：

- 搜索引擎收录。
- AI Agent 发现和检索。
- AI 辅助研究与问答。
- AI 内容摘要和知识整理。
- AI 模型训练，但须遵守适用法律及平台规则。
